correctness.rationale: A word in {p,m,u,v} defines a Munn interval and terminal vertex; p/m move one edge, u/v inspect one adjacent edge at cost one and leave the vertex unchanged. If a,b>0, left-first shortest exposure costs 2a+b-1 (using a left probe), right-first costs a+2b-1. Equality has precisely two words for each minimizing route; when a=b both contribute four. Boundary classes have the two monotone/probe representatives; D-width n needs n newly exposed edges and its shortest sweeps have 1,4,8 words in widths 0,1,at least 2. Summing cases gives the two displayed rational R series. Explicit one-counter inequalities prove R DCFL; its intersection with m^+vp^+ is nonregular by distinguishable prefixes. D templates are regular. Independent enumeration verified every R-class length and multiplicity for min length <=6; actual verifier separately checks longer prefixes through n=9.
